parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of metal, typically stainless steel or aluminum alloy, with a slim elongated shape.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain balance and fit.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of metal, similar to the left leg, with a curved end for ear support.
parts.Functional_description: It provides lateral support and stability, ensuring the glasses stay in place on the wearer’s head.
parts.Movement_description: It can pivot around the hinge joint to fold or unfold, allowing compact storage and comfortable wearing.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lenses)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the frame and lenses. The frame is metallic, while the lenses are made of polycarbonate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in place and provides the main optical function of vision correction or sun protection.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and rigid, serving as the central structure to which the legs are attached via hinges.
